name: Exterior Engineered Wood Siding Finish Coat 1
intent: Finish coat 1. Spray 350 SF/hr, backroll 350 SF/hr (separate tasks), brush/roll 100 SF/hr. Coat 2 is ~10% faster in separate module.
doctrine: Finish coat 1 for engineered wood siding. Same rates as natural wood siding (vertical application, same physical action). Spray and backroll separate tasks. Profile modifier (lap 1.0, panel 1.10, t1_11 1.80) and texture modifier (smooth 1.0, cedarmill 1.20, roughsawn 1.30) apply. No intercoat sanding on siding.
